subject.title: fix(auth): allow OpenAI OAuth for audio transcription

question: Should OpenClaw officially support ChatGPT/Codex OAuth bearer credentials for native OpenAI `/v1/audio/transcriptions` batch STT, despite the current non-agent API-key-only documentation?
rationale: The code can safely constrain credential forwarding to native OpenAI endpoints, but whether subscription OAuth is a supported batch-transcription product contract—rather than an observed upstream behavior—requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept native OAuth batch STT
options.body: Merge the guarded exception after rebasing, documenting the auth contract, and rerunning focused current-head proof.

options.title: Keep batch STT API-key-only
options.body: Close this PR and instead add clear validation, doctor guidance, and documentation for existing OAuth-profile audio configurations.

recommendation.title: Accept native OAuth batch STT
recommendation.body: Merge the guarded exception after rebasing, documenting the auth contract, and rerunning focused current-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the current API-key-only OpenAI audio behavior and are the strongest available history-based owner for deciding whether to revise that contract.
